authority: Measured values are authoritative; source geometry and texture contents were not supplied.
suitability: conditional: reconstruct a described procedural particle experience, not image-to-mesh extraction

silhouette: two frontal hemispheres separated by a fissure
motion: GPU semi-implicit spring at fixed 60 Hz
limits: original particle quad is probable, not certain
original anatomy and atlas pixels unavailable
responsive scroll mapped to actual portfolio sections

proceduralDecisions.brain: bilateral ellipsoidal cortex with continuous warped sulci, cerebellar surface and brainstem; atlas starts in profile
proceduralDecisions.bulb: surface of revolution with tapered neck and threaded base
proceduralDecisions.globe: sphere with original simplified continent polygons
proceduralDecisions.mark: three extruded triangles from existing portfolio identity
proceduralDecisions.explosionMultiplier: 3.4 + 16 * seededRandom^0.9; source texture unknown; calibrated under Dala's literal camera (50 deg vertical FOV at z=10) to ~150 visible triangles at explode=1
proceduralDecisions.explosionRank: 0.6 * normalized brain height + 0.4 * seededRandom (x L); reproduces the top crest observed at explode~0.53 and its absence at explode=1
proceduralDecisions.particleQuad: replaced: particles are wireframe pyramids (6 edge prisms of a tetrahedron, like Dala's py-lod1.glb), extent 0.06 world units, bar circumradius 0.06 of the edge
proceduralDecisions.randomness: deterministic indexed sine hash; no per-frame random positions
proceduralDecisions.brainFit: scale 0.896, offset (+0.8, +0.665) world units at factor 4.35, lateral axis x1.6; fitted to Dala's hero at f=0.12
